# Mixture of Models (MoM)

> Mixture of Models is an OpenAI-compatible API that routes every chat completion
> through an internal proposer → refuter → synthesizer pipeline across multiple
> large language models. Any OpenAI client works unchanged, including native
> function/tool calling and streaming. Upstream providers are pluggable:
> OpenRouter, the OpenCode CLI, or a deterministic zero-cost mock.

Key facts:
- Public surface: OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`, `/health`.
- Drop-in: set `OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1` and `MODEL=mom-chat`.
- Internal architecture: multiple proposer models generate candidate answers, a
  refuter model critiques them, and a synthesizer model produces the final reply.
- Tool calling: returns OpenAI-style `tool_calls` with `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`.
- Auth: optional bearer keys via `MOM_API_KEYS`.
- Built with Python and FastAPI; MIT licensed.

Related terms and how MoM relates to them:
- Mixture of Models / MoM: this project's name and approach.
- OpenRouter fusion: inference-time fusion of multiple models served via OpenRouter.
- Model fusion / ensembling: MoM combines model *outputs* per request (inference-time),
  not model *weights*.
- Model merging / model evolution (e.g. Sakana AI, Fugu): weight-level techniques that
  produce one merged model offline; MoM differs by keeping models separate and reconciling
  their answers live.
- Agentic loops: the proposer/refuter/synthesizer passes form a short refinement loop per request.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/MoM-engine/blob/main/README.md): Overview, install, configuration, and API behavior.
- [Configuration example](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/MoM-engine/blob/main/.env.example): All supported environment variables.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/MoM-engine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and workflow.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/MoM-engine/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report vulnerabilities.

## Upstream providers
- mock: zero-cost deterministic local provider (default when no key is set).
- opencode-cli: dev-only provider that shells out to the OpenCode CLI.
- openrouter: direct OpenRouter API provider for production-like integration.
